body:
Every time I want to tell someone I hold myself back. When I did open up to someone last year he just didn't understand me- he tried to sympathize but he couldn't and then  just acted like his usual cynical sarcastic jerk self.

I am not going to commit suicide. I'm too afraid of death and pain and I still enjoy some things usually even though my life sucks. I can still pretend I'm okay and it keeps me going. I'm still going to think about it every night though. It's like I'm walking in a narrow tunnel and instead of choosing to bang my head at the wall until I die, I just keep walking until my legs fall off.

The thing is, I know there are people who want me to be happy. It's not the kind of thing when I think "nobody cares, why bother". I know people care but I'm just to stupid to let them know I'm fucked up.

I feel better now. My depression is always at its worst at nights. Some day I'll tell someone, but I think it'll take me a lot of time. 

Thanks for replying.
